worldcombat.skill.aurawheel.summary: Rolls the energy stored in the user's cheeks along the ground; using it raises Speed, and its type follows the user's form.
Rolls along the ground: %1$s physical damage; roll distance %2$s blocks, %3$s blocks per tick, collision radius %4$s blocks; on impact the user's Speed rises by %5$s stages. The type follows the user's form.
